question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The couple was trolled by everyone.

options.text: The social media trolled the couple.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Everyone trolled the couple."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the couple" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "trolled" to "was trolled" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "everyone."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Everyone trolled the couple."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The social media trolled the couple." – This changes the subject to "social media" which is not accurate.
 
• **Option 3: **"Everyone had trolled the couple." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"Everyone trolls the couple." – Incorrect tense (present simple).

``
